variants.optimizerInput: Skate Rack, Room Decor, Tier 3, Garden Glow. Make ONE compact freestanding roller-skate rack as the entire product on a plain light-neutral studio background. Rack-first design: two thick warm-oak vertical side posts, one broad stable base, three sage-green horizontal rails, and four large open cubbies with obvious rectangular storage openings. Put only ONE matching pair of simple quad roller skates in the two lower cubbies; leave the upper cubbies empty so the rack structure dominates. Each skate must have one clean boot silhouette, one visible truck, and exactly four large round wheels; keep every skate fully inside the cubby. Add visible bolts/joints, weight-bearing feet, one tiny leaf cutout and a restrained soft green accent glow. Center the entire rack with generous negative space and a grounded shadow. NO long top shelf, NO skateboard/snowboard-like boards, NO loose gear, NO room scene, NO wall shelving, NO cropped objects, NO floating parts, NO malformed partial skates, NO text or logos.

Skate Rack, Room Decor, Tier 3, Garden Glow. Design ONE simple A-frame roller-skate organizer that reads instantly as a rack at small Store-card size. Use two sturdy botanical-green metal A-frame uprights joined by three honey-oak shelves, a wide floor base, visible cross-bracing, and four large storage bays. Show one clearly formed pair of quad skates together in a single lower bay and keep the other bays empty; the skates must have readable boot uppers and four large wheels each. The dominant silhouette must be the rack, not the skates. Use clean three-quarter product view, full object inside frame, at least 15 percent clear margin, crisp joints and feet, grounded shadow, subtle Garden Glow leaf accent. NO room background, NO long plank/board shapes, NO skateboards, NO loose skates, NO edge crops, NO tiny clutter, NO text or logos.
